newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche offers employee shares at 30 pct discount.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche offers employee shares at 30 pct discount.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Thursday it was offering its employees shares at a 30 percent discount to the current market price.

Each employee is entitled to buy 13 shares at a price of 57.23 marks ($34.04). The shares closed bourse trade at 85.10 marks on Thursday, up 0.62 marks. The shares have to be held for six years before they can be sold.

Deutsche said it was also offering present and past employees up to 47 additional shares depending on their length of employment at the bank. The shares can be bought at the same discount and employees can sell after just three years.
Deutsche said the offer was aimed at boosting employee ownership of the bank's shares. Some 51,300 employee shareholders own 2.5 percent of the bank's shares.
